title: V11 Task State
description: Schema for task-state JSON written by sync-tasks hook. Internal runtime state, not user-configured.

active_task_id.description: Canonical active task id (sync-tasks writes this; track-autonomy reads it for proof-of-work)

active_task_sprint.description: Sprint label of the currently active task (from metadata.sprint)

active_task_gate.description: Gate label of the currently active task (from metadata.gate)

active_agent_id.description: Agent-id of the owner of the currently active task (written by sync-tasks from TaskUpdate owner; read by track-autonomy for audit attribution)

blocked_tasks.description: Currently blocked task IDs (subset of total, populated by sync-tasks)

finding_tasks.description: Map of finding task id to metadata — tracked separately from regular tasks by sync-tasks when type=finding.

dark_code_advisories.description: Dark Code Layer 1 advisory counters — tracks how many complex/novel tasks lack spec_test_requirements

findings_summary.description: Aggregate counts of finding tasks by severity (populated by sync-tasks when type=finding tasks exist)

dedup_rate.description: Fraction of findings that were duplicates

review_summary.description: Aggregate of per-task adversarial-lite review outcomes (V11.15). Populated by sync-tasks from artifacts.review on completed tasks. Project-scoped rollup; per-agent detail lives in ~/.agent-metrics/agent-effectiveness.jsonl.

escalated.description: CRITICAL errors escalated to orchestrator (no auto-edit)
